text: At its meeting on Thursday, April 25, 2024, the Toronto Parking Authority – Audit and Risk Management Committee considered Item PR5.6 and made recommendations to the Board of Directors of the Toronto Parking Authority. Summary from the report (April 6, 2024) from the President, Toronto Parking Authority: Toronto Parking Authority aspires to be the world's best provider of sustainable parking, Bike Share and last mile mobility experiences. As part of this journey, Management is continually seeking opportunities to streamline its policies, systems, and decision-making processes to provide greater agility for Team Toronto Parking Authority to deliver real-time outcomes and compete in the marketplace. The purpose of this report is to provide the Toronto Parking Authority - Audit and Risk Management Committee and the Board of Directors of the Toronto Parking Authority with a preview of…
The Board of Directors of the Toronto Parking Authority deferred the item to its next meeting on July 19, 2024.
